ezekiel.1.p1.b1.text: On the fifth day of the month—it was the fifth year of the exile of King Jehoiachin—

ezekiel.1.p1.b2.text: In the thirtieth year, on the fifth day of the fourth month, while I was among the exiles by the River Kebar

ezekiel.1.p1.b3.text: the heavens opened and I saw visions of God.

ezekiel.1.p1.b4.text: the word of the LORD came directly to Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi … And there the LORD’s hand was upon him.

ezekiel.1.p2.b1.text: I looked and saw a whirlwind coming from the north, a great cloud with fire flashing back and forth and brilliant light all around it

ezekiel.1.p2.b2.text: and within it was the form of four living creatures

ezekiel.1.p2.b3.text: but each had four faces and four wings.

ezekiel.1.p2.b4.text: the soles of their feet were like the hooves of a calf, gleaming like polished bronze … Under their wings on their four sides they had human hands.

ezekiel.1.p2.b5.text: The form of their faces was that of a man, and each of the four had the face of a lion on the right side, the face of an ox on the left side, and also the face of an eagle.

ezekiel.1.p2.b6.text: lightning flashed out of it. The creatures were darting back and forth as quickly as flashes of lightning.

ezekiel.1.p3.b1.text: I saw a wheel on the ground beside each creature with its four faces. … The workmanship of the wheels looked like the gleam of beryl … Their workmanship looked like a wheel within a wheel.

ezekiel.1.p3.b2.text: Their rims were high and awesome, and all four rims were full of eyes all around.

ezekiel.1.p3.b3.text: when the creatures rose from the ground, the wheels also rose … because the spirit of the living creatures was in the wheels.

ezekiel.1.p3.b4.text: Spread out above the heads of the living creatures was the likeness of an awesome expanse, gleaming like crystal.

ezekiel.1.p3.b5.text: I heard the sound of their wings like the roar of many waters, like the voice of the Almighty, like the tumult of an army.

ezekiel.1.p3.b6.text: And there came a voice from above the expanse over their heads as they stood still with their wings lowered.

ezekiel.1.p4.b1.text: Above the expanse over their heads was the likeness of a throne with the appearance of sapphire

ezekiel.1.p4.b2.text: From what seemed to be His waist up, I saw a gleam like amber, with what looked like fire within it all around. … The appearance of the brilliant light all around Him was like that of a rainbow in a cloud on a rainy day.

ezekiel.1.p4.b3.text: This was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of the LORD. And when I saw it, I fell facedown and heard a voice speaking.
